items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: Archie had Maged, Charles Greenlee on trombone. He had Dave Burrell on piano and Joe Masontos (PHONETIC) on congar and Ottie on congas and Beaver Harris on drums. That was his band. ... I played. We played that weekend

ctx.x: I forgot, yeah, because they had all acts, different acts. That's true. He had Billy Green in a solo spot. He had Cal Massey on a solo spot. He had Beaver and he had Dave Burrell.
